_comment: FROZEN. Verified reachable from this machine at 13:45 JST 2026-09-12. Pinned so no agent guesses a URL.

odpt_train_information.CRITICAL_NOTE: Do NOT append '.json' - that triggers a redirect to a dead Azure blob (BlobNotFound). The extension-less path returns 200.
odpt_train_information.coverage: Toei operator ONLY (6 lines). No JR-East, no Tokyo Metro on the keyless mirror.
odpt_train_information.sample_text_normal: 現在、１５分以上の遅延はありません。

odpt_railway.use: odpt:stationOrder gives the station sequence per line -> join to odpt:Station coords to build polyline geometry

odpt_station.verified: 200, 149 items, ALL have geo:lat and geo:long

p2pquake_ws.note: May be silent for hours. POST /demo/replay is the demo guarantee, not this.

overpass.use: rail geometry for the JR/Metro lines absent from the ODPT keyless mirror
overpass.note: POST the query from a UTF-8 FILE, not a shell argument - Japanese line names get mangled by the Windows shell.

jreast_kanto_status.format: HTML scrape (no public JSON for per-line status)
jreast_kanto_status.CRITICAL_NOTE: JR East only reports delays of 30+ MINUTES (30分以上の遅れ). ODPT/Toei reports 15+ minutes. Different thresholds -- never present them as one uniform 'delay' semantic without disclosing this.
jreast_kanto_status.classify_by: Japanese status TEXT is authoritative, not the CSS class: 平常運転->normal, 遅延/運転状況/ダイヤ乱れ->delay, 運転見合わせ/運転中止->suspended, お知らせ->info notice
jreast_kanto_status.covers: JR-Yamanote, JR-Chuo-Rapid, JR-Chuo-Sobu, JR-Keihin-Tohoku, JR-Saikyo (+45 other JR East lines outside our registry)

jreast_kanto_notices.use: JR East service notices (planned works, long suspensions). Skip records where metainfo.dummy == '1'.
jreast_kanto_notices.note: This is a NOTICE feed, not per-line realtime status.

jreast_delay_certificate_BLOCKED.verified: 403 Akamai Access Denied from server-side curl (any UA/Referer). Reachable only from a real browser.
jreast_delay_certificate_BLOCKED.content: Even when reachable it holds ONE placeholder record with metainfo.dummy=1, title literally '...ダミー...'. No delay data.
jreast_delay_certificate_BLOCKED.verdict: UNUSABLE -- do not wire this. Use jreast_kanto_status instead.

odpt_bus_vehicles.verified: 200, 390 live Toei vehicles, dc:date matched wall-clock to the second
odpt_bus_vehicles.CRITICAL_NOTE: Vehicles have NO geo:lat/geo:long. Position must be DERIVED from odpt:fromBusstopPole -> odpt:toBusstopPole plus odpt:fromBusstopPoleTime. Never claim GPS accuracy: this is an interpolated position between two known stops.
odpt_bus_vehicles.fields: odpt:busroutePattern, odpt:fromBusstopPole, odpt:toBusstopPole, odpt:fromBusstopPoleTime, odpt:busNumber, odpt:frequency, odpt:note (JP route label)
odpt_bus_vehicles.note: This RECOVERS the PRD's cut bus stretch goal WITHOUT the ODPT token -- the keyless mirror carries Toei bus data after all.
odpt_bus_vehicles.frequency_trap: odpt:frequency is the feed's 30s UPDATE INTERVAL, not a service headway -- it cannot be used to derive leg duration. A11 instead calibrated BUS_SPEED_KMH=12.3 as the median of 416 real scheduled legs from odpt:BusTimetable (p25 8.7 / p75 16.6), so a mid-leg position can be off by ~+/-30% of the leg. Buses past their estimate are snapped to the next stop as 'at-stop' rather than floated past it.

odpt_busstop_poles.use: stop coordinates; join key for vehicle positions and route geometry

odpt_busroute_patterns.use: odpt:busstopPoleOrder gives the ordered stop sequence per pattern -> join to BusstopPole coords to build route polylines. Same technique as odpt:Railway stationOrder for rail.
odpt_busroute_patterns.note: Use ug:region for real road-following geometry; odpt:busstopPoleOrder remains the stop sequence. Straight-line fallback applies to 9 patterns only.
odpt_busroute_patterns.CORRECTION: Orchestrator note was WRONG. BusroutePattern DOES carry geometry: 748 of 757 patterns have a ug:region LineString following the ACTUAL ROAD (45,524 vertices total). Only the 9 without one fall back to stop-to-stop straight lines, tagged geometrySource='stop-to-stop'. Verified by A11.
